$comment: Lighthouse CI config — the SINGLE source of truth for the performance gate. Docs: https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse-ci/blob/main/docs/configuration.md. Every assertion is `error`-level, so `lhci assert` (pnpm lighthouse:assert) exits non-zero and FAILS CI on any regression. TARGET URL: deliberately not committed here — the audited site is the PUBLISHED WIX SITE, provided per-environment via the WIX_SITE_URL env/repository variable and passed at collect time: `lhci collect --config=./lighthouserc.json --url="$WIX_SITE_URL/"` (the lighthouse-ci workflow and scripts/validate-site-e2e.sh do this). Category floors (0.85 perf / 0.90 a11y-bp-seo) and resource budgets are inherited from the fork ancestor and suit a lean content site; Wix's Thunderbolt runtime ships more JS than a hand-rolled theme, so the script budget (200 KB gz) is likely the first thing you will raise after measuring a real published site — change it here, in one reviewed commit, with measured numbers, never by softening the workflow. RESOURCE BUDGETS use `resource-summary:<type>:size` in BYTES (KB x 1024) — the only budget mechanism compatible with Lighthouse 12, which removed budgets.json/performance-budget. Size = over-the-wire transferSize; the Wix CDN serves assets compressed. `skipAudits` drops is-on-https/uses-http2 so the gate also works against http preview tunnels. Mobile preset is the Lighthouse default.
